title: Flow World Re-entry Packet
description: Portable handoff shape for passing current working coordinates between a human and one or more AIs without treating prior conclusions as authority.

current_position.description: Where the work currently is. Describe position, not a retrospective summary.

confirmed.description: Items supported strongly enough to carry forward as confirmed within the stated boundary.

unknown.description: Questions or facts that remain unresolved. Do not fill these by inference.

boundary.description: Limits on what may be claimed, reused, or acted on from this packet.

question.description: The unresolved point this probe is intended to move.

observation.description: The smallest concrete observation to make next.

why.description: Optional reason this probe has high information value.

next_probe.description: At most one next probe. Null is valid when no justified probe has been chosen.

stance.description: Epistemic stance carried with this item. Do not promote it without new evidence.

sources.description: Where carried-forward claims came from. A source entry does not by itself make a claim confirmed.

topic.description: What the work is currently about. Keep this short and concrete.

key_point.description: The central issue that makes the current position meaningful.

recent_flow.description: A compact movement trace, not a retrospective story. Prefer a short chain such as 'observed A -> B changed -> C held -> now checking D'.

direction.description: The current direction of movement, including what the work is intentionally not expanding into when relevant.

flow.description: Optional lightweight movement layer. Carries topic, key point, recent motion, and direction without turning prior narrative into authority.

status.description: An active marker exists only while a temporary branch is open.

current_position.description: The working coordinate captured before entering the temporary branch.

stance.description: Epistemic stance carried with this item. Do not promote it without new evidence.

references.description: Concrete pointers needed to identify what the captured position actually referred to.

return_point.description: Optional one-use return marker. Do not overwrite it while branching; clear it after successful return.
